company_profile: Action is a European non-food discount retailer with stores across Europe, whose central Data Analytics team builds models for supply chain, commerce, store operations and real estate.
title: Data Scientist
summary: Data Scientist with 8+ years working end-to-end, from scoping and exploratory analysis to modelling, deployment and monitoring, across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Builds regression, classification, clustering and time-series forecasting models with Python, PySpark and SQL on Databricks, productionised with MLflow, Docker and CI/CD, and applies LLMs through RAG, agentic workflows and fine-tuning where they help. Works closely with business teams. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

experience_edits.original: Shipped anomaly detection and demand forecasting on 15+ KPIs
experience_edits.new: Shipped anomaly detection and time-series demand forecasting on 15+ KPIs across 500+ telecom network devices using Isolation Forest and Holt-Winters, enabling earlier detection and proactive network planning.

experience_edits.original: Deployed a production SLA breach prediction system
experience_edits.new: Productionised an SLA breach prediction model with LightGBM, FastAPI and MLflow, using GPT-3.5 for real-time root-cause analysis and remediation recommendations per breach, reducing downtime by 67%.

experience_edits.original: Built an event-correlation engine clustering alarms with Sentence-BERT
experience_edits.new: Built an event-correlation engine clustering network alarms with Sentence-BERT and DBSCAN, tracing the cascading effect of alarm floods to the root event and improving semantic alarm classification by 73.5%.

experience_edits.original: Developed an XGBoost propensity model predicting personal-loan applications
experience_edits.new: Developed an XGBoost classification model predicting personal-loan applications within 7 days of contact, enabling targeted outreach and customer prioritization for the business.

project.name: Store Demand Forecasting Engine
bullets: Built a store and product-level demand forecasting engine for discount retail, combining Holt-Winters baselines with LightGBM on PySpark features to support replenishment planning for supply chain teams.
Evaluated forecasts with rolling backtests against the baseline, tracked runs in MLflow on Databricks, and served forecasts through a Dockerised FastAPI service with drift and accuracy monitoring.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Data Scientist role in Action's central Data Analytics team. For more than eight years I have worked on data science end-to-end, from scoping with business teams and exploring messy data to deploying models and watching them in production, most recently as a senior data scientist on healthcare data.

A retailer built on low prices lives or dies by good forecasts and lean operations, which is exactly where models make a visible difference to stores and supply chain. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Zwaagdijk-Oost together and settle there long term.

I would bring forecasting and production habits. At Viavi I shipped anomaly detection and Holt-Winters demand forecasting on 15+ KPIs across 500+ network devices, and deployed a LightGBM SLA breach model with FastAPI and MLflow that reduced downtime by 67%. More recently I have built RAG and agentic workflows, useful for teams that want LLMs on top of their data.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It has taught me to build for the people who use a tool every day, and to keep things simple enough that they do. I would welcome a conversation about the role.
